title: 对抗性风格优化：基于GRPO的风格触发增强视觉语言模型越狱攻击
summary: 提出ASO模块，利用GRPO优化图像编辑模型叠加风格化修改，利用MLLMs理解能力与防御机制间的风格不一致性，显著提升现有视觉越狱攻击的成功率。
summary_en: Proposes ASO, a plug-and-play module that fine-tunes an image-editing model via GRPO to superimpose stylistic modifications, exploiting stylistic inconsistency in MLLMs to enhance jailbreak attack success rates.
